comment: A FULL HTML PAGE answering an ajax update (the expired-session shape: the login/expired page comes back with status 200) must never be silently swallowed or morphed - it must surface through the error contract. This scenario points a container's data-updateUrl at a sessionless component URL (which answers with the full 'session timed out' page), fires an update, and asserts (a) the container content is untouched and (b) the built-in error banner appeared with the session message.

steps.name: the full page was NOT morphed into the container
